sanskrit:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते ।
ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति ॥ ४-२५॥
iast:
daivamevāpare yajñaṃ yoginaḥ paryupāsate
brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṃ yajñenaivopajuhvati 4-25
translation: Some YOGIS perform sacrifice to DEVAS alone (DEVA-YAJNA) ; while others offer sacrifice as sacrifice by the Self in the Fire of BRAHMAN (BRAHMA-YAJNA) .
